name: Freewind Post
summary: Freewind Post guards the Horde’s hold in Thousand Needles from a high canyon mesa. Tauren lifts and winding rope bridges lead to its refuge, where the Horde faces centaur warbands and prepares for the frontier.

sections.title: A Fortress in the Sky
sections.body:
Freewind Post clings to the canyon mesas, where height helps guard its people. Galak centaur command the arid floor, but cannot climb the sheer cliffs or easily breach the heavy wooden lifts that carry Horde travelers upward. Rope and plank bridges link the post to neighboring spires, sheltering the outpost above.

Harpies screech along the bluffs, while the tauren tend the nearby wyvern grounds at Highperch. There, they cull wild eggs and raise the hatchlings as loyal wind rider mounts for the Horde.

sections.title: Shadows from Darkcloud Pinnacle
sections.body:
Freewind Post watches the Grimtotem tribe at Darkcloud Pinnacle, northwest across the canyon. Once tolerated as stubborn traditionalists, the Grimtotem under Chieftain Arnak now turn to kidnapping, murder, and violence. Suspicious rituals and whispers of dark power surround the nearby peaks.

The local tauren watch the skies and rope bridges with growing dread. Their most dangerous enemies may sit entrenched across the canyon winds, not prowl the salt flats below.

faq.q: Why is Freewind Post built so high up on a mesa?
aliases: why is freewind post in the sky
faq.answer: Freewind Post rises above the canyon floor to guard against hostile Galak centaur warbands. Centaur excel on flat ground, but cannot climb sheer cliffs or easily breach the tauren’s mechanical wooden lifts.

faq.q: How do you get up and down from the post?
aliases: how to get up freewind post
faq.answer: Most travelers ride the large mechanical wooden lifts at the base of the main mesa. A back route winds between neighboring rock pillars over rope bridges and wooden ramps. One careless step can mean a lethal fall to the canyon floor.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Freewind Post and the Grimtotem?
faq.answer: Relations between Freewind Post and the Grimtotem are deeply strained. The Grimtotem at Darkcloud Pinnacle, northwest of the post, face accusations of murder, kidnapping, and unprovoked hostility toward other tauren. The post’s defenders keep watch on their neighbors.

faq.q: What importance does Highperch have to the post?
faq.answer: Highperch is an ancestral nesting ground for wild wyverns just across the canyon. The tauren of Freewind Post watch the beasts and cull eggs from their nests, then raise them as wind rider mounts for the Horde.

angles.text: As a shu'halo, you can see how Freewind Post uses mesa heights to guard against traditional centaur marauders while tending the bluffs’ ancestral wyverns.
As a member of the Horde, you can rely on Freewind Post as a major sanctuary and flight connection between the Southern Barrens and Tanaris. It supports travel across central Kalimdor.
